content: Our system was designed to cluster documents from a (potentially infinite) real-word data stream. The datasets typically used in the literature (TDT, Reuters) have a small number of clusters ( INLINEFORM0 20) with coarse topics (economy, society, etc.), and therefore are not relevant to the use case of media monitoring we treat - as it requires much more fine-grained story clusters about particular events. To evaluate our approach, we adapted a dataset constructed for the different purpose of binary classification of joining cluster pairs. We processed it to become a collection of articles annotated with monolingual and crosslingual cluster labels.
